text_block_list.text:
Early one morning, Эйр Грув is waiting
outside
the academy gate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Morning, Эйр Грув! You're quite the
early bird
today!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I woke up feeling quite refreshed,
so I
thought it would be nice to say
good morning to
everyone.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'll join you! I'm on the disciplinary

committee, after all.
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Heh, it'd be a pleasure to have you here.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув and Бамбу Мемори's lively

greetings echo across the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
